seo.description: Palavras dos casais e das famílias que celebraram com a Picnic Club: pedidos de casamento, piqueniques de luxo e casamentos íntimos em Portugal.

title: Testemunhos
intro: Os testemunhos são escritos pelos nossos clientes depois da experiência e aprovados pela Picnic Club antes de serem publicados. Podemos corrigir erros de escrita ou retirar dados pessoais, sem mudar o sentido.

items.text:
An Unforgettable Proposal in Portugal!

We honestly couldn’t have asked for a more perfect experience! My fiancé planned the most beautiful marriage proposal with Ana, and every single detail was absolutely flawless. From the moment we arrived, everything felt magical, elegant, and incredibly thoughtful.

Ana is truly amazing at what she does. She is professional, warm, attentive, and has such a wonderful eye for detail. The setting was breathtaking, the decorations were stunning, and the entire atmosphere felt like something out of a fairytale. She went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, creating a moment we will cherish for the rest of our lives.

What impressed us most was how personal and effortless she made the entire experience feel. Planning a surprise proposal from abroad can be stressful, but Ana made us feel completely at ease every step of the way.

If you’re planning a proposal, romantic celebration, or a special experience in Portugal, we cannot recommend Ana enough. She made our dream proposal a reality, and we will forever be grateful!

Thank you, Ana, for giving us a memory we’ll treasure forever. Portugal will always have a special place in our hearts!

Working with Ana and The Picnic Club was an absolute dream! For our first entre nous edition, she created the most beautiful picnic setup on the beach in Comporta, and it was truly one of the highlights of the weekend.

Every detail was thought through with so much care, from the gorgeous table styling and soft textiles to the flowers and delicious food. It felt effortless, elegant and so personal, exactly the atmosphere we dreamed of. Our guests were completely enchanted the moment they arrived, and everyone is still talking about it.

Ana is warm, professional and so easy to work with. She understood our vision straight away and brought it to life even more beautifully than we imagined. We can’t wait to work with her again for our next gatherings!

Ana was always super helpful and very communicative. She was always willing to go above and beyond on requests to make sure that everything went well and got done.
Thank you for everything!

An unforgettable experience thanks to Ana and her amazing team!

Ana organized my marriage proposal in Comporta in less than a month, taking care of absolutely everything with incredible professionalism, creativity and attention to detail.

From the very beginning, I felt completely at ease. She was always available, anticipated every need and went far beyond my expectations, adding beautiful personal touches that made the moment truly unique.

Her genuine kindness, dedication and deep knowledge of Comporta make all the difference. Everything was perfectly organized, allowing me to simply enjoy one of the most important moments of my life.

I cannot recommend Ana and the Picnic Club highly enough. Thank you, Ana, for making this moment so magical and unforgettable!

Nuestra experiencia de elopement con picnic en la playa fue increíble. Todo salió perfecto y vivimos un momento súper especial, íntimo y diferente, justo como lo imaginábamos. La decoración, el picnic y el entorno hicieron que todo fuese precioso, y además tuvimos la suerte de disfrutar de un atardecer espectacular.

Ana fue nuestro punto de referencia durante todo el proceso, encargándose de la decoración y de coordinar al equipo para que todo saliera perfecto. Gracias a Ana y a todo el equipo por hacerlo tan especial. Sin duda, repetiríamos la experiencia y la recomendamos muchísimo. 💍✨

Foi uma experiência simplesmente maravilhosa! Fizemos o luxury picnic na Comporta com a nossa família e foi tudo perfeito, desde o início até ao fim. A atenção ao detalhe, o cuidado e a simpatia fizeram toda a diferença. Sentimo-nos verdadeiramente especiais e muito bem recebidos.
